newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bital brokerage ups stake in Wings.
newsitem.headline: Bital brokerage ups stake in Wings.

text.p: Mexico's Casa de Bolsa Bital, the brokerage for the Bital financial group, has aquired 43 percent of the recently listed restaurant chain Wings, also known as Corporacion Mexicana de Restaurantes, a Bital official said on Thursday.
Bital has acquired nearly 30 million shares with the idea of buying more and maintaining a long-term interest, Ignacio Zubiria, national director of Bital's banking unit.
"We like this business a lot, we like how it's been managed, it has no debts and they are looking to grow with new stores," Zubiria said.
Bital has been buying shares in Wings since it went public on June 2, he said.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom, +525 728-7912))
